scope: Regenerated Trust only: 132 participants and 241 previously accepted runs. UGR not yet quantified here.
coverage_definition: Count of atlas ROI voxels inside reconstructed FEAT mask with finite nonconstant residuals, divided by all atlas ROI voxels. HarvardOxford cortical maxprob-thr25 insular cortex on the common output grid. This is data support, not a measure of registration accuracy, tissue correspondence, signal dropout, or tSNR.
notes: Current 0.8 config gate applies to common spatial ROI intersection; the per-run 0.8 regeneration checks are review flags, not exclusion rules.

Both sub-10834 runs show gross spatial misalignment on the exported montages; low ROI support is a consequence or companion finding. The failed registration stage and any acquisition loss are not established.

If sub-10834 were not recovered and both Trust runs were excluded, a both-task analysis requiring at least one run of each task would retain at most 131 of these 132 participants. No such exclusion has been applied.
All other 239 Trust runs have full ROI support, so their common Trust ROI support is 100% under this metric. This does not establish common Trust+UGR coverage.

Full-sample signal-quality characterization additionally requires preprocessed BOLD signal/dropout and tSNR assessment and UGR measurements. Residuals are not appropriate for mean-BOLD/tSNR assessment.
